title: Criteria/matrix mismatch
text: Criteria/matrix mismatch: the normative sweep-enablement row omits the recognized-off input required by AC18. Add the recognized-off outcome and its required non-sweep action so implementers do not have to infer it.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in 3c5c359, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Spec PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews spec PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
